description_en: Modifies the acceleration region of a site. Updates the acceleration configuration of a site to adapt to traffic distribution changes or improve the access experience for users in specific regions
description_zh: 修改单个站点的加速区域。更新站点的加速配置，以适应流量分布变化或提升特定地区用户的访问体验
name: UpdateSiteCoverage

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to query the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口查询获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The target acceleration region to change to. Valid values:
domestic: the Chinese mainland only.
global: global.
overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

<props="china">If the value is set to domestic or global, the site corresponding to SiteId must have a valid ICP filing.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
修改到的目标加速区域。取值：
domestic：仅中国内地。
global：全球。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）。

<props="china">当取值为 domestic 或 global 时，SiteId 对应的站点必须已完成 ICP 备案。</props>
parameters.name: coverage
